properties.name: Every release brings reflow2's site up to date, and the version gate fails a page left at an older release
properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-10-09, during the v0.81.0 cut: "make sure to update flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2 documentation appropriately /req". A line the gate checks is used rather than a written rule, because a rule an agent must remember at the cut is the kind measured to be missed.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: A new step of flow:release-cut, with the gate that holds it: each site page names the release it was checked against, and check_doc_versions fails when it names another. The pages were brought up to date for v0.81.0.
